3.speaker: Narrator
3.text: It had been a week since my meeting with Duke Reinhart in Pales.

4.speaker: Narrator
4.text: I had signed an official document ceding ownership of the Aureus gas field to the Grand Duchy of Pales. Elena and the Palesian economic minister were busy drawing up our deal to purchase the exploration rights.

11.speaker: Narrator
11.text: I had signed an official document ceding ownership of the Aureus gas field to the Grand Duchy of Pales. According to reports, LesPower would shortly purchase the exploration rights to the field.

12.speaker: Narrator
12.text: The Alliance of Nations had accepted our request to arbitrate ownership of the Aureus gas field. Preliminary hearings were to begin soon.

13.speaker: Narrator
13.text: In the meantime, Lespian prime minister Patricio Alvarez had contacted Laurento, asking to speak with me.

14.speaker: Narrator
14.text: I was spending the week at my palace in Monqiz. Laurento visited to brief me ahead of the phone call.

15.speaker: Narrator
15.text: He stepped in front of my desk and bowed.

18.speaker: Player_Romus
18.text: "No time for small talk. Prime Minister Alvarez will be calling soon."

19.speaker: Player_Romus
19.text: "I won't know if it's a good afternoon or not until I've found out what Lespia wants from me."

20.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
20.text: "Well enough. Though I must say I'm worried by the increasing tensions in Southern Merkopa."

21.speaker: Player_Romus
21.text: "I'll do my best to defuse tensions. Just call me Romus the Defuser."

22.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
22.text: "Very well. What did you want to know about him?"

23.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
23.text: "Right you are. Forgive the inappropriate greeting."

24.speaker: Player_Romus
24.text: "I understand that President Smolak may have lingering security concerns after the bombing."

25.speaker: Player_Romus
25.text: "Isn't there anything we can do? President Smolak can't keep holding on to Zille forever."

27.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
27.text: "It's not entirely up to you. I hope the upcoming Alliance of Nations session on South Merkopa will provide us with some clarity."

28.speaker: Narrator
28.text: He smoothed one of the ends of his moustache.

29.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
29.text: "I have filed a complaint with the Alliance of Nations. Presumably this will be addressed during the upcoming South Merkopa session."

30.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
30.text: "For now, though, we have Prime Minister Alvarez to worry about."

32.speaker: Player_Romus
32.text: "Did my father ever talk to him?"

42.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
42.text: "Well... He can't be happy that Pales has reneged on its gas deal."

43.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
43.text: "His country's energy demands have skyrocketed since joining ATO. I've heard rumors of massive new infrastructure investments."

44.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
44.text: "Naturally involving the Prime Minister's own construction company, Alvarez Industries."

45.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
45.text: "Well... He can't be happy that AN arbitration is delaying Lespia's access to the Aureus gas field."

46.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
46.text: "Well... He must be happy that Rizia is not challenging Lespia for access to the Aureus gas field."

47.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
47.text: "No. His Majesty Valero died mere months after Alvarez won the 1949 election."

48.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
48.text: "He must have sent his obligatory congratulations. In private, though, he referred to the young man as 'the viper in a diaper'."

49.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
49.text: "Considering the only reason he entered politics was to avoid going to jail?"

50.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
50.text: "Rare is the world leader who doesn't enjoy a little drink on the job. Or a big one."

51.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
51.text: "But no, Alvarez has apparently acknowledged his problem and entered a rehabilitation program. He's as sober as an Archpriestess. For now."

52.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
52.text: "No charge has successfully been leveled against him. But in my opinion, he can only be trusted to protect his own best interests."

70.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
70.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn04_Alvarez_Alcoholic"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn04_Alvarez_Father"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn04_Alvarez_Trustworthy"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn04_Alvarez_Want"] == true

71.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
71.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn04_Alvarez_Alcoholic"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn04_Alvarez_Father"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn04_Alvarez_Trustworthy"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn04_Alvarez_Want"] == true) == false

72.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
72.text: "What questions did you have about Mr. Alvarez?"

73.speaker: Player_Romus
73.text: "That'll be all. I'm ready for the phone call."
73.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn04_Alvarez_Alcoholic"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn04_Alvarez_Father"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn04_Alvarez_Trustworthy"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn04_Alvarez_Want"] == true

75.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
75.text: "Very good, Your Majesty. I'll meet you afterwards for a debriefing."

76.speaker: Narrator
76.text: An assistant brought in the blue telephone that was used for calls with heads of state.

78.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
78.text: "Good afternoon, King Romus. This is Patricio Alvarez."

79.speaker: Player_Romus
79.text: "This is His Majesty Romus Toras, Ruler of Rizia, Commander of the Royal Rizian Armed Forces, Duke of Valenqiris and Protector of the Rezenid Empire."

80.speaker: Player_Romus
80.text: "How is everything in Lespia, Mr. Prime Minister?"

81.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
81.text: "Quite the mouthful. May your reign be as long as your titles."

82.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
82.text: "I'll be honest with you, Your Majesty."

88.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
88.text: "Things were going a lot better a week ago."

92.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
92.text: "Our deal with Reinhart was a year in the making."

93.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
93.text: "I'll be honest with you, Your Majesty."

98.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
98.text: "I was a lot better a week ago."

99.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
99.text: "You must have some idea why I'm calling."

100.speaker: Player_Romus
100.text: "Something to do with the gas field, I assume?"

103.speaker: Narrator
103.text: I heard him swallow on the other end of the line.

104.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
104.text: "And one hour with you was enough to make the Duke of Pales have a sudden change of heart?"

106.speaker: Narrator
106.text: I heard him sigh on the other end of the line.

107.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
107.text: "I was heartened to hear of the results of your meeting with Duke Reinhart."

108.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
108.text: "I had an inkling that Rizia might try to obstruct our gas deal with Pales. I'm happy that was not the case."

109.speaker: Player_Romus
109.text: "Rizia has gone up against the combined might of Pales and Lespia before. We won't make that mistake again."

110.speaker: Player_Romus
110.text: "Actually, Duke Reinhart tried to double-cross you. But I refused his offer."

111.speaker: Player_Romus
111.text: "I'd be a fool to interfere with Lespia's plans, now that you've got ATO behind you."

113.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
113.text: "Thank you for turning him down. And for delivering me this information."

115.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
115.text: "I've heard you're something of an untraditional monarch. Maybe there's a way for us to work together."

119.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
119.text: "I've been hesitant to reach out to your kingdom in the past. But maybe there's a way for us to work together."

120.speaker: Player_Romus
120.text: "Apparently he likes me more than you."

121.speaker: Player_Romus
121.text: "Lespia joined ATO. That was the last straw for both of us."

122.speaker: Player_Romus
122.text: "We had the better offer. It's that simple."

123.speaker: Player_Romus
123.text: "Pales recognized Rizia's rightful claim to the field. You should do so as well."

124.speaker: Player_Romus
124.text: "The truth is that Pales has always shared a closer affinity with Rizia than Lespia."

130.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
130.text: "You're willing to let Wehlen tread all over you. But you saddle Rizia with more gas than you need because you're worried about ATO?"

131.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
131.text: "I may be new at this Prime Minister thing. But I know when someone is making a business mistake."

132.speaker: Player_Romus
132.text: "Zille is a local dispute. I see superpowers as far more of a threat."

133.speaker: Player_Romus
133.text: "The deal with Pales has been made, Mr. Prime Minister. It can't be undone."

134.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
134.text: "Shelling out for more natural gas than you need while Wehlen is still treading all over you?"

135.speaker: Player_Romus
135.text: "Rizia's energy needs are greater than you presume."

136.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
136.text: "There are no 'local disputes' in Merkopa these days, Your Majesty. You realize President Smolak has the long arm of Malenyev guiding him."

137.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
137.text: "We both know that's nonsense. My energy executives are still floating around in the Aureus field as we speak."

138.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
138.text: "Are you building nuclear weapons? I don't think so."

140.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
140.text: "I've been following the situation in Zille. It seems to me like you could use help with this debacle."

142.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
142.text: "I may be new at this Prime Minister thing. But I know when someone is making a business mistake."

143.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
143.text: "Saddling yourself with gas you don't need while Wehlen is still treading all over you?"

144.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
144.text: "Here I am, about to land the gas deal of a lifetime."

145.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
145.text: "And then my business partner calls me up and tells me we have to wait for AN arbitration."

146.speaker: Player_Romus
146.text: "You really thought Rizia would cede the field without a fight?"

147.speaker: Player_Romus
147.text: "You're lucky it's only that. Duke Reinhart wanted me to buy the field out from under you."

148.speaker: Player_Romus
148.text: "I'm only observing protocol, Mr. Alvarez. You would do the same if I laid claim to one of Lespia's resources."

150.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
150.text: "I thought you were a shrewd king. One who knows which way the wind is blowing."

151.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
151.text: "Well, as of my last conversation with him, he is determined to fight for what rightly belongs to Pales."

153.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
153.text: "My legal counsel has a crystal-clear case for Palesian ownership of the gas field."

154.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
154.text: "You can talk about ANDOR rules all you want, but in the end, it's going to come down to your word versus ours."

155.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
155.text: "And who do you think has more sway with the Alliance of Nations?"

156.speaker: Player_Romus
156.text: "You're bluffing. The AN will have no choice but to side with Rizia."

157.speaker: Player_Romus
157.text: "I understand I might lose. But I am not going to back down on this."

158.speaker: Player_Romus
158.text: "If you want Rizia to give up its claim on the field, you're going to have to present one hell of a counter-offer."

159.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
159.text: "Are you sure about that? One hundred percent, absolutely sure?"

160.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
160.text: "Because if you aren't, I have a proposition for you."

161.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
161.text: "Not 'might', Your Majesty. You will lose. After wasting a lot of unnecessary time and money."

162.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
162.text: "If you want to avoid all that, I have a proposition."

163.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
163.text: "As it happens, I do have a proposition that might interest you."

166.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
166.text: "And frankly, with Lespia on his side, he has an unimpeachable case."

169.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
169.text: "I've been following the situation in Zille. It seems to me like you could use help with this debacle."

170.speaker: Player_Romus
170.text: "What debacle? Our countries have an agreement."

171.speaker: Player_Romus
171.text: "Thanks, but I have everything under control."

172.speaker: Player_Romus
172.text: "I am growing concerned about the timely return of the region, yes."

174.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
174.text: "So President Smolak has promised to return Zille as scheduled, despite the recent incident?"

177.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
177.text: "He's a slippery man, Smolak. You won't get your territory back unless you tighten your grip on him."

179.speaker: Player_Romus
179.text: "I already have a plan. It doesn't involve Lespia."

180.speaker: Player_Romus
180.text: "Are you offering to intervene, Mr. Prime Minister?"

181.speaker: Player_Romus
181.text: "And how do you propose we do that?"

182.speaker: Player_Romus
182.text: "You catch flies with honey, not vinegar. I'm not going to risk inflaming hostilities with Wehlen."

183.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
183.text: "I'm not suggesting hostility. I'm suggesting Lespia provide assistance from the sidelines."

184.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
184.text: "Of course Lespia can't do that. But we can provide some assistance from the sidelines."

185.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
185.text: "By speaking up on your behalf at the upcoming AN session, for example."

186.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
186.text: "Of course Lespia can't interfere directly. But we can provide some assistance from the sidelines."

187.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
187.text: "All I'm suggesting is that we pitch in from the sidelines."

188.speaker: Player_Romus
188.text: "It's not a debacle. Wehlen and Rizia have an agreement."

189.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
189.text: "And President Smolak has promised to honor the terms of that agreement, despite the bombing?"

192.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
192.text: "He's a slippery man, Smolak. You won't get your territory back unless you tighten your grip on him."

197.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
197.text: "You're willing to let Wehlen tread all over you. But you shell out for more gas than your country needs because you're worried about ATO?"

198.speaker: Player_Romus
198.text: "Thanks, but I have everything under control."

199.speaker: Player_Romus
199.text: "Not that it's your business, but yes, I am growing concerned about the timely return of the region."

201.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
201.text: "So President Smolak has promised to honor the terms of your agreement, despite the bombing?"

202.speaker: Player_Romus
202.text: "I already have a plan. It doesn't involve Lespia."

203.speaker: Player_Romus
203.text: "Are you offering to intervene, Mr. Prime Minister?"

204.speaker: Player_Romus
204.text: "And how do you propose we do that?"

205.speaker: Player_Romus
205.text: "You catch flies with honey, not vinegar. I'm not going to risk inflaming hostilities with Wehlen."

206.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
206.text: "I'm not suggesting hostility. I'm suggesting Lespia provide indirect assistance."

207.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
207.text: "By speaking up on your behalf at the upcoming AN session, for example."

208.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
208.text: "We wouldn't interfere with whatever you have in motion. But we can provide indirect assistance."

209.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
209.text: "Of course Lespia can't do that. But we can provide indirect assistance."

210.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
210.text: "Of course Lespia can't interfere directly. But we can provide assistance from the sidelines."

211.speaker: Player_Romus
211.text: "That's it? You expect Rizia to give up our gained rights to the gas field for that little?"

212.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
212.text: "You wouldn't have to give them up entirely."

213.speaker: Player_Romus
213.text: "That's it? You'd expect us to give up our claim on the gas field for that little?"

214.speaker: Player_Romus
214.text: "Unfortunately, Rizia needs natural gas more than we need help with Wehlen."

215.speaker: Player_Romus
215.text: "You'd have to make a very persuasive case for us."

216.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
216.text: "I'm a charming man. Everyone says so."

218.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
218.text: "It's more than you'll get if you continue down the arbitration path."

219.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
219.text: "Cede the Aureus field to Pales, and in addition to the assistance I just promised, we'll sell you one-quarter of the exploration rights."

221.speaker: Player_Romus
221.text: "How do I know I can trust you?"

222.speaker: Player_Romus
222.text: "That's an insult, Mr. Alvarez. Those rights are ours to begin with."

223.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
223.text: "My lying days are behind me, Your Majesty."

224.speaker: Player_Romus
224.text: "You wouldn't be bargaining if you thought you had an airtight case."

225.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
225.text: "I'm trying to make sure we both get something out of this, Your Majesty."

226.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
226.text: "A certain... social club I'm in has taught me the importance of service to others."

227.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
227.text: "A certain... social club I'm in has taught me the importance of accountability."

233.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
233.text: "What'd His Majesty say? Only good things, I hope."

234.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
234.text: "One thing we have in common, then."

235.speaker: Player_Romus
235.text: "You may be sober, but I don't believe for a second that you've changed your ways."

236.speaker: Player_Romus
236.text: "You're not the bogeyman my councilors made you out to be."

237.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
237.text: "You don't have to believe me. All you have to do is say yes."

238.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
238.text: "But I'm not trying to be your friend. I'm just trying to help you avoid embarrassment."

239.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
239.text: "No. But you don't have to like me. All you have to do is say yes."

240.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
240.text: "This isn't a plea for cooperation, Your Majesty. It's a chance for you to avoid embarrassment."

241.speaker: Player_Romus
241.text: "Thanks for the offer, Mr. Alvarez. I'll remember your patronizing tone when I crush you and Pales in court."

245.speaker: Player_Romus
245.text: "I know full well what I'm up against. But win or lose, I want to see how arbitration plays out."

246.speaker: Player_Romus
246.text: "Even if I were interested, I can't afford the gas offer. If arbitration is my only chance for a piece of Aureus, I have to take it."

247.speaker: Player_Romus
247.text: "I know when to back down. I'll accept the gas offer for a quarter of the field, but I don't want or need your help with Wehlen." [-4 Budget, +2 Energy Per Turn in Future]

248.speaker: Player_Romus
248.text: "All right. Sell me 25% of the gas rights and help me out with Zille, and I'll withdraw Rizia's claim to the Aureus field." [-4 Budget, +2 Energy Per Turn in Future]

249.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
249.text: "Your prerogative, Your Majesty. It's a deal."

251.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
251.text: "I'm looking forward to celebrating our agreement in person in Kyrute. Over, say, coffee."

257.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
257.text: "No need for aggression, Your Majesty. This is a civil process."

258.speaker: Player_Romus
258.text: "You got what you were asking for. No need to butter me up further."

259.speaker: Player_Romus
259.text: "Thank you for calling, Mr. Prime Minister."

262.speaker: Player_Romus
262.text: "A pleasure speaking with you, Mr. Prime Minister."

265.speaker: Player_Romus
265.text: "Have you forgotten I hold the cards here? My navy has the field surrounded right now."

269.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
269.text: "I wonder what will happen if you're forced to use it?"

270.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
270.text: "The longer your ships stay there, the worse Rizia looks in the eyes of the international community. And as you know, there's a big AN meeting coming up."

272.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
272.text: "What'd His Majesty say? Only good things, I hope."

273.speaker: Player_Romus
273.text: "You may be sober, but I don't believe for a second that you've changed your ways."

274.speaker: Player_Romus
274.text: "It would be very convenient to have this whole mess fixed by the time that meeting rolls around."

275.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
275.text: "You don't have to believe me. All you have to do is say yes."

276.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
276.text: "You're right about that. The Wehlen situation's already messy enough without a naval standoff on your hands."

280.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
280.text: "Oh. And of course, I expect the prompt removal of your naval reinforcements from the field."

281.speaker: Narrator
281.text: We said our goodbyes and hung up.

283.speaker: Narrator
283.text: I sat there for a while, wondering what I had gotten myself into.

287.speaker: Narrator
287.text: I'd avoided a legal battle, but to what end?

288.speaker: Narrator
288.text: Were Duke Reinhart and Prime Minister Alvarez right? Was I doomed to lose this battle?

289.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
289.text: "Four countries share the mining rights to the MITZ. It's no mystery that two of them want it nationalized."

290.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
290.text: "If you and I don't hold the line against the Malenyevists, they'll take everything."

291.speaker: Player_Romus
291.text: "'Comrade' Saltana can nationalize our gold over my dead body."

292.speaker: Player_Romus
292.text: "It's a complex topic. The mines are on Morellan land, but we've invested millions in them."

293.speaker: Player_Romus
293.text: "We've exploited Morella's resources enough. Saltana can do what she wants with the MITZ."

294.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
294.text: "There you have it. We're in agreement."

295.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
295.text: "I hope you'll repeat that sentiment the next time the MITZ board convenes."

296.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
296.text: "It's not complex to me, Your Majesty."

297.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
297.text: "I hope you'll see it my way by the next  MITZ board meeting."

298.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
298.text: "So you're fine with losing all the money you've invested there? And all the revenue the mines have been generating for you?"

299.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
299.text: "If you don't, you should know I'll do whatever I must to protect Lespia's interests. Whether that benefits Rizia or not."

300.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
300.text: "Then I'll do what I must to protect Lespia's own interests. Which may or may not benefit your kingdom in the end."

301.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
301.text: "And hell, I'll even put in a good word for you at the Alliance of Nations. Try and help you out of this sticky situation you're in with Wehlen."

303.speaker: Player_Romus
303.text: "I do. Please help by any means necessary."

304.speaker: Player_Romus
304.text: "Thank you for the offer, but we've got the Zille situation under control."

307.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
307.text: "We'll celebrate next month in Kyrute. Over coffee."

312.speaker: Narrator
312.text: I sat in my office for a while after that, wondering what kind of bargain I had made.

316.speaker: Narrator
316.text: I sat in my office for a while after that, wondering if turning down Lespia's offer was the right decision.

317.speaker: Player_Romus
317.text: "Having Lespia on our side would hurt our chances with Wehlen, not help them."

318.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
318.text: "I disagree, Your Majesty. We could be instrumental in bringing the plight of your kingdom to the greater international community."

319.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
319.text: "Cancel on Pales, allow Lespia to go through with our planned purchase, and we'll sell you 25 percent of the gas rights."

322.speaker: Player_Romus
322.text: "What makes you think Duke Reinhart would still sell to you after offering the field to me?"

323.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
323.text: "He doesn't have an alternative, does he?"

325.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
325.text: "Reinhart's practically a teenager. Turning to you was his version of a tantrum."

326.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
326.text: "I will warn you that Reinhart's practically a teenager. Turning to you was his version of a tantrum."

327.speaker: Player_Romus
327.text: "And why should I accept a quarter of the field instead of the rights to the whole thing?"

328.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
328.text: "Duke Reinhart is practically a teenager. Turning to you was his version of a tantrum."

329.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
329.text: "To save yourself trouble further down the line."

330.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
330.text: "Eventually, Reinhart will come back to us. I'm just trying to make sure Rizia is not left with nothing when he does."

332.speaker: Player_Romus
332.text: "You may have a point. I was already beginning to have second thoughts about the Pales deal."

333.speaker: Player_Romus
333.text: "This isn't generosity. This is an attempt to turn Rizia and Pales against each other."

334.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
334.text: "A certain... social club I'm in has taught me the importance of service to others."

335.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
335.text: "We're both intelligent men, Your Majesty. We don't have time for the whims of a brat."

336.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
336.text: "A reunion was never in the cards, Your Majesty. Do you think the Duke has so easily forgotten the way your people tried to conquer his?"

337.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
337.text: "But it's up to you. Keep your deal if you believe that's what's best for your country."

338.speaker: Player_Romus
338.text: "That is in fact what I believe. Please don't reach out to me again, Mr. Alvarez."

339.speaker: Player_Romus
339.text: "I do appreciate the offer. But my answer is no."

340.speaker: Player_Romus
340.text: "You make a convincing case. I'll call off the deal and accept a smaller share of the gas field rights. But I don't need or want your help with Wehlen." [Revert Pales Field Deal and Lose Paid Budget, +2 Energy Per Turn In Future]

341.speaker: Player_Romus
341.text: "You're right. It's better for us if we cancel the deal. But I'm still counting on a share of the gas rights and your full support with Wehlen." [Revert Pales Field Deal and Lose Paid Budget, +2 Energy Per Turn In Future, Diplomatic Support]

347.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
347.text: "Fine with me. Good luck sorting everything out on your own."

348.speaker: Player_Romus
348.text: "Thanks for your call, Mr. Prime Minister."

351.speaker: Player_Romus
351.text: "Thanks for your call, Mr. Prime Minister."

352.speaker: Player_Romus
352.text: "I look forward to it as well."

353.speaker: Player_Romus
353.text: "I'm sure you are, now that you've gotten what you wanted."

355.speaker: Narrator
355.text: I sat in my office as daylight faded, wondering if I had made the right decision.

356.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
356.text: "And I'm looking forward to seeing you in Kyrute."

365.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
365.text: "I would expect more civility from a king."

384.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
384.text: "Our Rumburgian allies have expressed their support for our naval blockade, as expected. And they are sure to be of use during the AN arbitration process."

385.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
385.text: "However, the nation of Morella has yet to support or denounce us. The same goes for Derdia."

386.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
386.text: "Meanwhile, my requests for Wehlen to give us an updated timeline on the Zille handover have been repeatedly ignored..."

390.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
390.text: "Our Rumburgian allies have expressed their intent to support us during the arbitration process, at least."

391.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
391.text: "However, the nation of Morella has yet to express an opinion either way. The same goes for Derdia."

392.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
392.text: "We can expect improved relations with Lespia and Pales now that we've ceded ownership of the gas field."
392.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_Military_BlockDrillship"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Pales_ANDORArbitration"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_GasField_Cede"] == true)

396.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
396.text: "However, our neighbors don't seem happy that we've allowed Lespia to take control of such a large stretch of the Antacean."

397.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
397.text: "Wehlen still refuses to give us an updated timeline for the Zille handover. Losing the gas field may have something to do with it..."

398.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
398.text: "We can expect improved relations with Pales now that we're on the verge of a gas deal."
398.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_Military_BlockDrillship"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Pales_ANDORArbitration"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_GasField_Cede"] == true) == false)

399.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
399.text: "However, we mustn't forget about Wehlen. My requests for an updated timeline on the Zille handover have been repeatedly ignored..."

400.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
400.text: "Furthermore, Morella and Derdia have expressed interest in purchasing energy from us."

401.speaker: Player_Romus
401.text: "To hell with Wehlen. If they won't give us Zille back, we'll just have to take it from them."

403.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
403.text: "I have filed a complaint with the Alliance of Nations. Presumably this will be addressed during the upcoming South Merkopa session."

404.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
404.text: "I would like to give him the benefit of the doubt. But the lack of a response is very worrying."

405.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
405.text: "Is that what it's like being a monarch? Make a decision, forget about the consequences?"

408.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
408.text: "You and I both know how large the Aureus gas field is. Lespia definitely doesn't need all of it."

409.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
409.text: "What if we made a deal? We'll sell you 25 percent of the rights we're buying from Pales."

410.speaker: Player_Romus
410.text: "I'm not buying it, Mr. Prime Minister. What's the catch?"

411.speaker: Player_Romus
411.text: "What makes you think I want anything to do with the Aureus field?"

412.speaker: Player_Romus
412.text: "If I wanted gas from that field, I'd purchase it from Pales directly."

413.speaker: Player_Romus
413.text: "I would be interested. Tell me more."

417.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
417.text: "Now, that's not true. I happen to know that Duke Reinhart detests you."

418.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
418.text: "That's not the way it works. Lespia controls the rights to the entire field now."

419.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
419.text: "Fortunately, I have no such qualms about Rizia."

420.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
420.text: "Anyone who wants a piece of it has to go through us."

422.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
422.text: "A certain... social club I'm in has taught me the importance of service to others."

426.speaker: Player_Romus
426.text: "They tried to get me to join that club in my wilder days. I refused."

431.speaker: Player_Romus
431.text: "That's nice. But I still don't believe you would offer such a large stake out of the goodness of your heart."

432.speaker: Player_Romus
432.text: "I am glad that your faith gives you guidance, as it does me."

433.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
433.text: "Amazing, isn't it? Like wiping the fog off a window and finally being able to see."

434.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
434.text: "It's amazing, Your Majesty. Like wiping the fog off a window and finally being able to see."

435.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
435.text: "Believe it or not, this is my offer."

436.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
436.text: "No use in being coy, Your Majesty."

437.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
437.text: "Every country in Merkopa is begging for a whiff of that gas. Even 25 percent of the field would grant you considerable power."

439.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
439.text: "A certain... social club I'm in has taught me the importance of service to others."

440.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
440.text: "I'm not talking about religion. But never mind."

442.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
442.text: "In my case, I saw that it's time for Rizia and Lespia to grow closer together."

443.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
443.text: "I feel it's finally time for Rizia and Lespia to grow closer together."

444.speaker: Player_Romus
444.text: "I still don't understand your sudden show of generosity."

446.speaker: Player_Romus
446.text: "Perhaps we ceded it a little too hastily."

447.speaker: Player_Romus
447.text: "Except that we'd still be beholden to Pales."

448.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
448.text: "Let us worry about Pales, Your Majesty."

449.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
449.text: "On the contrary, Your Majesty. This is the best possible outcome."

452.speaker: Player_Romus
452.text: "So Lespia wants a closer partnership with Rizia?"

454.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
454.text: "Look at what we're up against. The forces of Malenyevism closing in on all sides."

455.speaker: Player_Romus
455.text: "Morella's turn towards the east worries me as well."

456.speaker: Player_Romus
456.text: "You're right. We have our differences, but neither of us wants Merkopa to turn into a socialist empire."

457.speaker: Player_Romus
457.text: "Malenyevism and Arcasian liberalism are just two sides of the same coin to me."

458.speaker: Player_Romus
458.text: "It's capitalist vultures like you that keep me up at night, not the specter of Malenyevism."

459.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
459.text: "We're not strictly Arcasian liberals over here in Lespia, either."

460.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
460.text: "Hrm... Well, but you must still agree that the new prime minister of Morella is bad news for both of us."

462.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
462.text: "And at any rate, I'm sure you'll agree that the new prime minister of Morella is bad news for both of us."

464.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
464.text: "And I'm sure you'll agree that the new prime minister of Morella is bad news for both of us."

465.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
465.text: "Exactly, Your Majesty. Their new Prime Minister Saltana is bad news for both of us."

466.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
466.text: "Getting up on her high horse, spouting made-up claims about pollution and human rights just because she has Valgsland in her corner..."

467.speaker: Player_Romus
467.text: "The Meftiem International Trade Zone nationalization debate. I agree, it's pure rubbish."

468.speaker: Player_Romus
468.text: "I don't know if we see eye to eye on this, Mr. Prime Minister."

469.speaker: Player_Romus
469.text: "What does this have to do with the gas field, Mr. Alvarez?"

471.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
471.text: "We're on the same side with Aureus. We've got to be a team here, too."

473.speaker: Player_Romus
473.text: "Aha. There's the ulterior motive I was looking for."

474.speaker: Player_Romus
474.text: "You bet I will, Mr. Alvarez. And I'll take you up on that gas offer." [-3 Budget, +2 Energy Per Turn In Future]

475.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
475.text: "I knew you were a smart man."

476.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
476.text: "Not an ulterior motive. Just laying the facts on the table."

479.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
479.text: "You do? That's not what I heard, but suit yourself."

481.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
481.text: "Looking forward to getting rich off Palesian gas together."

482.speaker: Player_Romus
482.text: "Perfect. This could be the beginning of a new era."

483.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
483.text: "If there's one thing we Lespians love, it's a long-term commitment."

486.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
486.text: "Natural gas is the future, isn't it? Any little bit is better than none."

487.speaker: Player_Romus
487.text: "We do. But I won't make any promises regarding the MITZ." [-3 Budget, +2 Energy Per Turn In Future]

489.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
489.text: "Hell, I'll even put in a good word for you at the Alliance of Nations. Try and help you out of this sticky situation you're in with Wehlen."

491.speaker: Player_Romus
491.text: "I do. Please help by any means necessary."

492.speaker: Player_Romus
492.text: "Thank you for the offer, but we've got the Zille situation under control."

496.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
496.text: "He's like an eel, that President Smolak. You won't get what you want unless you tighten your grip on him."

497.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
497.text: "That's not what I heard. But suit yourself."

498.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
498.text: "He's like an eel, that President Smolak. You won't get what you want unless you tighten your grip on him."

499.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
499.text: "At any rate, I'm glad we could do business. We'll celebrate next month in Kyrute. Over coffee."

504.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
504.text: "We'll seal the deal soon after the Alliance of Nations meeting."

505.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
505.text: "I look forward to celebrating in person. Over coffee."

506.speaker: Player_Romus
506.text: "And the offer of assistance with Wehlen? That still stands?"

508.speaker: Player_Romus
508.text: "Fine. I'll withdraw both the Rizian navy and our claim to the field in exchange for 25 percent of the gas rights." [-4 Budget,  +2 Energy Per Turn in Future]

509.speaker: Player_Romus
509.text: "I will not back down that easily, Mr. Alvarez. We will proceed with arbitration, and my navy will stay in place."

510.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
510.text: "Very excellent, Your Majesty. You've saved us both a lot of trouble."

512.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
512.text: "We have a long fight ahead of us."

513.speaker: Player_Romus
513.text: "One that I am confident Rizia will win."

514.speaker: Player_Romus
514.text: "'We'? This is Pales' fight, not yours."

515.speaker: Player_Romus
515.text: "I hope for a civil and peaceful legal process."

516.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
516.text: "You know what would help with that? Withdrawing your military."

518.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
518.text: "You're right, Your Majesty. Lespia will not get directly involved."

520.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
520.text: "Ah, to have the confidence of a king."

521.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
521.text: "I heard your father was also confident that Rizia would reconquer Pales. I wonder what happened there?"

524.speaker: Player_Romus
524.text: "We are not closed to the idea, but I want to know more about what you have in mind."

525.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
525.text: "Let me help you with a brilliant and mutually beneficial idea."

541.speaker: Player_Romus
541.text: "I don't want to have anything to do with Lespia. Even if it means giving up access to the Aureus field."

542.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
542.text: "Suit yourself. I was only trying to be nice."

550.speaker: Player_Romus
550.text: "We can't make these sorts of financial commitments right now. Nothing changes in our action plan."

551.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
551.text: "And there's the matter of our shared interests in the Meftiem International Trade Zone. He must also be aware of Morella's nationalization intentions."

552.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
552.text: "And let me guess. He talked you into paying for the infrastructure. All that money gone, for results you won't see for years if at all."

553.speaker: Player_Romus
553.text: "So in your version of the deal, we'd get less gas from the field, but the pipeline would be free?"

554.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
554.text: "You got it. And if Aureus turns out to be a dud after all, you won't have lost a cent."

555.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
555.text: "And LesPower will take over whatever infrastructure costs are necessary to bring that gas from Aureus to Rizia's doorstep."

560.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
560.text: "Even if you had a claim, defending and enforcing it would cost you."

561.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
561.text: "And I don't just mean money. A resource-hungry monarchy clashing with its closest neighbors... do you really want that image for Rizia?"

564.speaker: Player_Romus
564.text: "Reinhart was the one who started this mess. And we're supposed to simply roll over to him?"

565.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
565.text: "You'd get championed as a peacemaker, and you'd still get gas out of the deal. I'd go for it, if I were in your shoes."

566.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
566.text: "We're on the same side here. Don't forget about our partnership in the MITZ."

567.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
567.text: "You're worried about someone trying to steal your resources away, you should look no further than your neighbor Ms. Saltana."

568.speaker: Player_Romus
568.text: "The Meftiem International Trade Zone nationalization debate. I agree, it's pure rubbish."

569.speaker: Player_Romus
569.text: "I don't know if we see eye to eye on this, Mr. Prime Minister."

570.speaker: Player_Romus
570.text: "That's an entirely different topic. We were talking about the gas field."

571.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
571.text: "Exactly! If Rizia and Lespia don't hold the line against the commies, they'll take everything."

572.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
572.text: "Resources are resources. And perhaps Rizia's time and energy are better spent protecting what you already have instead of going after something you don't."

573.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
573.text: "Well, we should. If Rizia and Lespia don't hold the line against the commies, they'll take everything."

574.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
574.text: "Getting up on her high horse, spouting made-up concerns about pollution and human rights just because she has Valgsland in her corner..."

575.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
575.text: "So how do you feel about a partnership?"

576.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
576.text: "LesPower will take care of any infrastructure needed to deliver the gas to Rizia. You'd barely even have to lift a finger."

580.speaker: Player_Romus
580.text: "You know what? If it helps grease the wheels on our gas deal, I will." [-3 Budget, +2 Energy Per Turn In Future]

584.speaker: Player_Romus
584.text: "I have to say upfront that I don't have the budget for this gas deal you're offering. But when it comes to the MITZ, we are on the same side."

585.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
585.text: "That's great to hear, Your Majesty. No worries about the gas."

587.speaker: Patricio Alvarez (R)
587.text: "But enough about Morella. Do we have a deal on Aureus?"

591.speaker: Player_Romus
591.text: "The gas field offer isn't within my budget. But I'll support you in the MITZ when the time comes."

592.speaker: Player_Romus
592.text: "Absolutely. And I'll back you against Morella if it means that much to you." [-3 Budget, +2 Energy Per Turn In Future]

595.speaker: Player_Romus
595.text: "I'm not going to accept the gas offer. But when it comes to the MITZ, Rizia has your back."
